summary: Completed testing of AnalogScoreboard integration and GroupMe channel creation with existing_bot_id. P0 AnalogScoreboard: VERIFIED working in LiveSpectatorView.js (pages) and EnhancedLiveStatsEntry.js. P1 GroupMe fix: VERIFIED - channels can be created with existing_bot_id without requiring GroupMe API credentials. Fixed a minor bug in GroupMeManager.js team sorting.

minor.issue: Returns 520 timeout intermittently - known issue from previous iterations

critical_code_review_comments: AnalogScoreboard component: Well-designed LED-style scoreboard with team colors, blinking colon, period display
LiveSpectatorView.js (pages): Correctly imports and uses AnalogScoreboard at line 2 and 294
EnhancedLiveStatsEntry.js: Correctly imports AnalogScoreboard at line 3, uses compact mode in renderStickyHeader at line 2094
Backend groupme.py: Properly handles existing_bot_id at lines 162-165, skips GroupMe API call when bot ID provided
GroupMeManager.js: Fixed team sorting bug - added null check for team.name in localeCompare call

test_credentials.admin_user: Set localStorage 'mlbl_current_user' with role: 'admin' and roles: ['admin']

seed_data_creation: Created test GroupMe channels via API and UI with existing_bot_id
context_for_next_testing_agent: AnalogScoreboard is used in two places: /app/frontend/src/pages/LiveSpectatorView.js (full scoreboard) and /app/frontend/src/components/unified-events/EnhancedLiveStatsEntry.js (compact mode). The unified-events/LiveSpectatorView.js does NOT use AnalogScoreboard. GroupMe channel CRUD is working correctly with existing_bot_id bypass.

analog_scoreboard_livespectatorview.details: LED-style digits displaying time, team scores with color-coded glow, period indicator, LIVE badge, team logos/initials. Dark metallic background renders correctly.

analog_scoreboard_enhancedlivestatsentry.details: Import at line 3, compact mode usage in renderStickyHeader at line 2094 with onTimeClick handler

groupme_channel_create_with_existing_bot.details: POST /api/groupme/channels with existing_bot_id='test_bot_123' returns 200 with channel_id and bot_id=test_bot_123

groupme_channel_list.details: GET /api/groupme/channels returns channels array with proper serialization (no MongoDB ObjectId)

groupme_channel_delete.details: DELETE /api/groupme/channels/{id} returns 200 and channel is removed from list

groupme_manager_ui_create_channel.details: UI form shows 'Use Existing Bot ID' option, channel created successfully via UI with existing bot ID

groupme_auto_load_groups.details: GroupMeManager.js useEffect at lines 41-44 auto-loads groups when entering create-channel view. Shows 'No GroupMe groups found' error correctly when API not configured.

team_sorting_error.issue: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'localeCompare') when teams array contains items with undefined name
team_sorting_error.fix: Added filter for valid teams and null-safe localeCompare: .filter(team => team && team.name).sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''))

mocked_features.groupme_api: GroupMe API calls to list groups require valid GROUPME_ACCESS_TOKEN which is not configured in preview environment. Channel creation with existing_bot_id works WITHOUT API credentials.

ui_tests_performed: LiveSpectatorView with AnalogScoreboard renders correctly for past game events
GroupMe Manager Dashboard displays integration status
GroupMe Channels view shows created channels with proper columns (Name, Type, Teams, Access, Status, Actions)
Add Channel form loads correctly with manual group ID and existing bot ID options
Channel created via UI with existing_bot_id appears in channels list
